headline: When I'm exhausted, I return 503 UNAVAILABLE – my brain's overloaded and needs maintenance before it can process any more requests.
caption:
When I'm exhausted, I return 503 UNAVAILABLE – my brain's overloaded and needs maintenance before it can process any more requests.

—
503 UNAVAILABLE: the server cannot handle the request right now, usually because it is overloaded or down for maintenance.
